_comment: THE source manifest. Both cortex (indexing) and quartz-ctx (serving) read this
file, so the two cannot disagree about which roots exist. Copy to
source          path to a crate's src dir, RELATIVE to the workspace root,
forward slashes. Windows backslashes also work but forward
slashes keep the file identical across machines.
scope           module-path prefix for this crate's units, so two crates that
both define `Config` stay distinguishable. Use null for the ONE
primary project - its units stay unprefixed and win ties in
get_item. Scope becomes quartz-ctx's origin tag verbatim, so
include_private index non-pub items too. Set TRUE for applications and binaries,
FALSE (omit) for libraries. A library publishes its API through
pub; an app does not - measured on the reference workspace,
pub-only showed 19% of a GUI app and 33% of a CLI, against 55%
